user.title: Spot prices
user.description: Choose the sensor(s) with spot prices in 15-minute intervals (e.g. OKTE integration). Today is required, tomorrow is optional.

data_description.price_today: Sensor whose attributes contain the price list (e.g. period_data).
data_description.price_tomorrow: Usually published around 14:00 for the next day.

tarifa.title: Purchase tariff
tarifa.description: Low tariff (NT) hours and purchase prices including distribution. Defaults match ZSE DD3 for EV owners.

data_description.nt_intervals: Format HH:MM-HH:MM separated by comma, e.g. 23:45-05:45, 13:45-15:45
data_description.sell_fee: Amount your buyer deducts from the spot price when you sell.
